title: NovaDesk Starter
text: $49 per month, up to 1,000 conversations per month, WhatsApp and web chat channels, email support.

title: NovaDesk Growth
text: $199 per month, up to 10,000 conversations per month, CRM integration, automatic lead scoring, priority support.

title: NovaDesk Enterprise
text: Custom pricing, unlimited conversations, SSO, a dedicated success manager and a 99.9% uptime SLA.

title: Free trial
text: Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required.

title: Support hours
text: Support hours are 9 AM to 6 PM IST, Monday to Friday.

title: WhatsApp
text: The WhatsApp Business API is supported on every plan.
